The per-rep purchase order report now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, so your example gives Anna 2 and Bob 1.

- **`DataStore.java`** (`findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep`, around line 6514): the purchase-order subquery has an `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` filter, the same one the per-quarter and per-weekday reports use. The Javadoc now says cancelled orders are not counted.
- **`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest.java`**: the `purchaseOrder` helper takes a status, defaulting to SENT. A new test, `cancelledPurchaseOrdersAreNotCounted`, covers your example.

`SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest` passes (4 tests, 0 failures). I didn't run the full suite. Nothing is committed.
